title: Council: ship a recoverable importer
final_plan:
## Direction
Build the importer in bounded batches.

## Evidence
E1: a reproduced interrupted write loses the current batch.

## Contributions
Adopt A's journal and B's small batch size. Reject C's rewrite because it breaks the existing API.

## Strongest objection
The journal adds disk writes. Measure throughput before rollout.

## Conditions
Repair R1 before release.

## Ordered actions and acceptance
1. Add the journal in importer.py. Interrupt after a write and verify recovery.
2. Add bounded batches. Compare every imported row with the source.
3. Roll out to one tenant. Roll back on lost or duplicated rows.

## Your decisions
Choose the initial tenant; other implementation work can begin.

B.label: Retain API
B.reason: The compatibility fixture fails under a rewrite.
